unicode_policy: All business text remains Unicode-capable; no varchar downgrade is permitted.
json_policy: JSON values remain application-owned JSON text with deterministic serialization and round-trip tests.
enum_policy: Logical enum/domain values remain constrained strings with application and database checks where supported.
timezone_policy: UTC-aware DateTime values remain timezone-aware at the ORM boundary and are normalized explicitly.
identifier_policy: Application UUID strings remain stable logical identifiers; no PostgreSQL sequence or RETURNING dependency is active.
transaction_policy: All Phase4 decisions and projections remain transactional; immutable unique keys and row locks provide retry/concurrency protection.
differences_and_exclusions: PostgreSQL 0001-0059 and the V3.5R1 Phase4 migration are historical provenance only.
PostgreSQL advisory locks are not active runtime behavior.
Azure SQL resources, Entra, deployment, Synology, SMB, and real AMEC data are outside this candidate.
Azure SQL service variant remains OWNER_DECISION_PENDING; compatibility proof is not Azure deployment proof.
